PullCountCalculatorActionParam.title: PullCountCalculatorAction Param
PullCountCalculatorActionParam.description: Run on the 珍贵物品 page. Reads 嵌晶玉 / 衍质源石 from IMS, optionally recognizes voucher And nodes on the current screen, then calculates pulls. Do not pass item_diamond or item_originium_recharge in items.

items.title: Items
items.description: Optional. Map of voucher catalog ID → Pipeline And recognition node (box_index → OCR digit).

optional.title: Optional
optional.description: When true, a recognizer miss stores 0 instead of failing. Omit to default true.
